expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Returns the current AngelScript execution world. Returns whether this is a game world. Returns whether this is an editor world. Returns whether this is a preview world. Returns the world network execution mode. Returns the current game-state actor. Returns dilated gameplay time in seconds, excluding pause. Returns dilated world time in seconds, including pause. Returns real elapsed world time in seconds. Returns the audio clock time in seconds.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: UWorld GetCurrentWorld(); | bool UWorld.IsGameWorld() const; | bool UWorld.IsEditorWorld() const; | bool UWorld.IsPreviewWorld() const; | ENetMode UWorld.GetNetMode() const; | AGameStateBase UWorld.GetGameState() const; | float64 UWorld.GetTimeSeconds() const; | float64 UWorld.GetUnpausedTimeSeconds() const; | float64 UWorld.GetRealTimeSeconds() const; | float64 UWorld.GetAudioTimeSeconds() const;
